name: Disable Nagle’s Algorithm
description: Sends small game packets immediately instead of batching them. Lowers ping spikes in online shooters.
script:
$root = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters\Interfaces'
Get-ChildItem $root | ForEach-Object {
  New-ItemProperty -Path $_.PSPath -Name TcpAckFrequency -Value 1 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
  New-ItemProperty -Path $_.PSPath -Name TCPNoDelay -Value 1 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
  New-ItemProperty -Path $_.PSPath -Name TcpDelAckTicks -Value 0 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
}
Write-Host 'Nagle disabled on all network interfaces.'

name: Disable Network Throttling
description: Removes the 10 packets/ms multimedia throttle and sets system responsiveness to 0 so games get full network + CPU time.
script:
$k = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Multimedia\SystemProfile'
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name NetworkThrottlingIndex -Value 0xffffffff -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name SystemResponsiveness -Value 0 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
revert:
$k = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Multimedia\SystemProfile'
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name NetworkThrottlingIndex -Value 10 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name SystemResponsiveness -Value 20 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null

name: Optimize TCP Stack
description: Enables RSS, normal auto-tuning and disables ECN / RFC-1323 timestamps for a leaner, lower-latency TCP stack.
script:
netsh int tcp set global autotuninglevel=normal
netsh int tcp set global rss=enabled
netsh int tcp set global ecncapability=disabled
netsh int tcp set global timestamps=disabled
netsh int tcp set global nonsackrttresiliency=disabled
netsh int tcp set supplemental template=internet congestionprovider=ctcp
revert:
netsh int tcp set global autotuninglevel=normal
netsh int tcp set global ecncapability=default
netsh int tcp set global timestamps=default

name: Free Reserved Bandwidth
description: Removes the 20% bandwidth QoS reserves for system tasks so games and downloads can use the full line.
script:
$k = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Psched'
New-Item -Path $k -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name NonBestEffortLimit -Value 0 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null

name: Prefer IPv4 over IPv6
description: Makes Windows resolve and connect over IPv4 first — avoids slow IPv6 fallbacks on servers that advertise both.
script: New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip6\Parameters' -Name DisabledComponents -Value 32 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null

name: Stop NIC Power Saving
description: Prevents Windows from powering down your network adapter, a common cause of random latency spikes and Wi-Fi drops.

name: Raise Port / Socket Limits
description: Raises MaxUserPort to 65534 and drops TIME_WAIT to 30s — helps games and launchers that open many connections.
script:
$k = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters'
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name MaxUserPort -Value 65534 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name TcpTimedWaitDelay -Value 30 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name DefaultTTL -Value 64 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null

name: Cloudflare DNS (1.1.1.1)
description: Fastest public resolver in most regions — applied to every active adapter.

name: Google DNS (8.8.8.8)
description: Reliable global resolver with strong anycast coverage.

name: Quad9 DNS (9.9.9.9)
description: Blocks known malicious domains at the DNS level.

name: AdGuard DNS (94.140.14.14)
description: Filters ads and trackers system-wide, before they are ever requested.

name: Flush DNS & Renew Lease
description: Clears the DNS resolver cache and renews your IP lease — fixes stale routes and "server not found" errors.
script:
ipconfig /flushdns
ipconfig /release | Out-Null
ipconfig /renew | Out-Null
Write-Host 'DNS cache flushed and IP renewed.'

name: Reset Network Stack
description: Full Winsock + TCP/IP reset. The nuclear fix for broken connectivity. Requires a reboot.
script:
netsh winsock reset
netsh int ip reset
ipconfig /flushdns
Write-Host 'Network stack reset — reboot to finish.'

name: Prioritize Games (MMCSS)
description: Tells the multimedia scheduler to give games top GPU and CPU priority instead of treating them as normal apps.
script:
$k = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Multimedia\SystemProfile\Tasks\Games'
New-Item -Path $k -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name 'GPU Priority' -Value 8 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name 'Priority' -Value 6 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name 'Scheduling Category' -Value 'High' -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name 'SFIO Priority' -Value 'High' -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name 'Affinity' -Value 0 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name 'Background Only' -Value 'False' -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null
revert:
$k = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Multimedia\SystemProfile\Tasks\Games'
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name 'GPU Priority' -Value 8 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name 'Priority' -Value 2 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name 'Scheduling Category' -Value 'Medium' -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null

name: Enable Game Mode
description: Turns on Windows Game Mode so background tasks and Windows Update pause while you play.
script:
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\GameBar' -Name AutoGameModeEnabled -Value 1 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\GameBar' -Name AllowAutoGameMode -Value 1 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
revert:
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\GameBar' -Name AutoGameModeEnabled -Value 0 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\GameBar' -Name AllowAutoGameMode -Value 0 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null

name: Disable Xbox Game Bar
description: Removes the Win+G overlay and its background hooks — one of the biggest sources of stutter on Windows 11.
script:
New-Item -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\GameDVR' -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\GameDVR' -Name AllowGameDVR -Value 0 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\GameDVR' -Name AppCaptureEnabled -Value 0 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\GameBar' -Name UseNexusForGameBarEnabled -Value 0 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\GameBar' -Name ShowStartupPanel -Value 0 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\System\GameConfigStore' -Name GameDVR_Enabled -Value 0 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
revert:
Remove-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\GameDVR' -Name AllowGameDVR -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\System\GameConfigStore' -Name GameDVR_Enabled -Value 1 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null

name: Disable Fullscreen Optimizations
description: Forces true exclusive fullscreen instead of the borderless-window emulation, cutting a frame of input lag.
script:
$k = 'HKCU:\System\GameConfigStore'
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name GameDVR_DXGIHonorFSEWindowsCompatible -Value 1 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name GameDVR_FSEBehavior -Value 2 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name GameDVR_FSEBehaviorMode -Value 2 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name GameDVR_HonorUserFSEBehaviorMode -Value 1 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
revert:
$k = 'HKCU:\System\GameConfigStore'
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name GameDVR_DXGIHonorFSEWindowsCompatible -Value 0 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name GameDVR_FSEBehavior -Value 0 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null

name: Optimizations for Windowed Games
description: Disables the DirectX swap-chain upgrade for windowed games so borderless mode behaves like legacy fullscreen.
script: New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\DirectX\UserGpuPreferences' -Name DirectXUserGlobalSettings -Value 'SwapEffectUpgradeEnable=0;' -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null

name: Enable Hardware GPU Scheduling
description: Lets the GPU manage its own memory queue. Reduces latency on modern NVIDIA/AMD cards. Reboot required.
script: New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\GraphicsDrivers' -Name HwSchMode -Value 2 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null

name: Disable Hardware GPU Scheduling
description: Turns HAGS off again — the safer choice on older GPUs and some capture/streaming setups. Reboot required.
script: New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\GraphicsDrivers' -Name HwSchMode -Value 1 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null

name: Disable Multiplane Overlay (MPO)
description: Fixes flickering, black screens and stutter caused by the MPO compositor on Windows 11.
script: New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\Dwm' -Name OverlayTestMode -Value 5 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null

name: GPU: Prefer Maximum Performance
description: Stops the GPU from downclocking between frames (NVIDIA/AMD power policy + PCIe link state always on).
script:
powercfg -setacvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT 501a4d13-42af-4429-9fd1-a8218c268e20 ee12f906-d277-404b-b6da-e5fa1a576df5 0
powercfg -setacvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT 54533251-82be-4824-96c1-47b60b740d00 bc5038f7-23e0-4960-96da-33abaf5935ec 100
powercfg -setactive SCHEME_CURRENT
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\GraphicsDrivers' -Name RmGpsPsEnablePerCpuCoreDpc -Value 1 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null

name: Disable Mouse Acceleration
description: Turns off "enhance pointer precision" so your aim is 1:1 with the sensor. Essential for FPS games.
script:
$k = 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Mouse'
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name MouseSpeed -Value '0' -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name MouseThreshold1 -Value '0' -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name MouseThreshold2 -Value '0' -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null
revert:
$k = 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Mouse'
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name MouseSpeed -Value '1' -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name MouseThreshold1 -Value '6' -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name MouseThreshold2 -Value '10' -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null

name: Zero Menu & Hover Delay
description: Removes the built-in delay before menus and hover tooltips appear — the whole desktop feels instant.
script:
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Desktop' -Name MenuShowDelay -Value '0' -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Mouse' -Name MouseHoverTime -Value '0' -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Desktop' -Name ForegroundLockTimeout -Value 0 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
revert:
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Desktop' -Name MenuShowDelay -Value '400' -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Mouse' -Name MouseHoverTime -Value '400' -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null

name: Fastest Keyboard Repeat
description: Minimum repeat delay and maximum repeat rate — snappier movement keys and chat typing.
script:
$k = 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Keyboard'
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name KeyboardDelay -Value '0' -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name KeyboardSpeed -Value '31' -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null
revert:
$k = 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Keyboard'
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name KeyboardDelay -Value '1' -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name KeyboardSpeed -Value '31' -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null

name: Kill Sticky / Filter Keys
description: No more accessibility popup when you hold Shift in a game.
script:
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Accessibility\StickyKeys' -Name Flags -Value '506' -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Accessibility\Keyboard Response' -Name Flags -Value '122' -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Accessibility\ToggleKeys' -Name Flags -Value '58' -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null
revert:
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Accessibility\StickyKeys' -Name Flags -Value '510' -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Accessibility\Keyboard Response' -Name Flags -Value '126' -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null

name: Xbox Services on Demand
description: Sets the four Xbox background services to Manual so they only start when a game actually needs them.

name: Disable Power Throttling
description: Stops Windows from throttling background game processes, launchers and voice chat.
script:
$k = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Power\PowerThrottling'
New-Item -Path $k -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name PowerThrottlingOff -Value 1 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null

name: Disable NVIDIA Telemetry
description: Switches off NVIDIA’s telemetry service and its three scheduled reporting tasks.
script:
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\NVIDIA Corporation\NvControlPanel2\Client' -Name OptInOrOutPreference -Value 0 -PropertyType DWord -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null
Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName 'NvTm*' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Disable-ScheduledTask -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null
Set-Service -Name 'NvTelemetryContainer' -StartupType Disabled -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Write-Host 'NVIDIA telemetry disabled (if present).'

name: High Precision Event Timer Off
description: Disables HPET and dynamic tick via BCD. Can raise 1% lows on some systems — revert if you see instability.
script:
bcdedit /deletevalue useplatformclock
bcdedit /set disabledynamictick yes
bcdedit /set useplatformtick yes
Write-Host 'Timer settings applied — reboot required.'

name: Optimize Shader Cache Size
description: Raises the DirectX shader cache so shaders are compiled once instead of every launch.
script:
$k = 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\DirectX\ShaderCache'
New-Item -Path $k -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name CacheSizeMB -Value 4096 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null

name: Ultimate Performance Plan
description: Unlocks and activates the hidden Ultimate Performance power scheme — no core parking, no idle downclocking.

name: High Performance Plan
description: Activates the standard High Performance plan — a safer choice for laptops than Ultimate.
script: powercfg /setactive 8c5e7fda-e8bf-4a96-9a85-a6e23a8c635c; Write-Host 'High Performance activated.'

name: Balanced Power Plan
description: Restores the default Balanced plan. Use this to undo aggressive power tweaks.
script: powercfg /setactive 381b4222-f694-41f0-9685-ff5bb260df2e; Write-Host 'Balanced plan activated.'

name: Disable CPU Core Parking
description: Keeps every core awake instead of parking idle cores — removes the wake-up penalty on sudden load.
script:
powercfg -setacvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_PROCESSOR 0cc5b647-c1df-4637-891a-dec35c318583 100
powercfg -setdcvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_PROCESSOR 0cc5b647-c1df-4637-891a-dec35c318583 100
powercfg -setactive SCHEME_CURRENT
Write-Host 'Core parking disabled.'

name: CPU Minimum State 100%
description: Locks the CPU at full clock on AC power. Maximum consistency, higher heat and power draw.
script:
powercfg -setacvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_PROCESSOR PROCTHROTTLEMIN 100
powercfg -setacvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_PROCESSOR PROCTHROTTLEMAX 100
powercfg -setactive SCHEME_CURRENT
revert:
powercfg -setacvalueindex SCHEME_CURRENT SUB_PROCESSOR PROCTHROTTLEMIN 5
powercfg -setactive SCHEME_CURRENT

name: Disable Hibernation
description: Turns hibernation off and reclaims several GB used by hiberfil.sys.
script: powercfg /h off; Write-Host 'Hibernation disabled, hiberfil.sys removed.'

name: Disable Fast Startup
description: Makes shutdown a real shutdown. Fixes dual-boot clock issues, stuck drivers and "restart fixes it" bugs.
script: New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Power' -Name HiberbootEnabled -Value 0 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null

name: Disable SysMain (Superfetch)
description: Stops the prefetcher that hammers SSDs and eats RAM with little benefit on modern hardware.
script:
Stop-Service -Name SysMain -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Set-Service -Name SysMain -StartupType Disabled -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Write-Host 'SysMain stopped and disabled.'
revert:
Set-Service -Name SysMain -StartupType Automatic -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Start-Service -Name SysMain -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

name: Disable Search Indexing
description: Stops the Windows Search indexer. Frees CPU and disk at the cost of slower Start-menu file search.
script:
Stop-Service -Name WSearch -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Set-Service -Name WSearch -StartupType Disabled -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
revert:
Set-Service -Name WSearch -StartupType Automatic -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Start-Service -Name WSearch -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

name: Non-Essential Services to Manual
description: Sets a curated list of rarely used services (fax, remote registry, diagnostics, retail demo…) to Manual so they stop auto-starting.

name: Tune Prefetch / Superfetch Keys
description: Disables prefetch and superfetch at the memory-manager level. Recommended for SSD/NVMe systems only.
script:
$k = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Memory Management\PrefetchParameters'
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name EnablePrefetcher -Value 0 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name EnableSuperfetch -Value 0 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
revert:
$k = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Memory Management\PrefetchParameters'
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name EnablePrefetcher -Value 3 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name EnableSuperfetch -Value 3 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null

name: Optimize Memory Management
description: Keeps the kernel and driver code in RAM instead of paging it out, and clears the pagefile policy overhead.
script:
$k = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Memory Management'
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name DisablePagingExecutive -Value 1 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name LargeSystemCache -Value 0 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
revert: New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Memory Management' -Name DisablePagingExecutive -Value 0 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null

name: Performance Visual Effects
description: Switches Windows to "best performance" animations while keeping font smoothing readable.
script:
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\VisualEffects' -Name VisualFXSetting -Value 2 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Desktop' -Name UserPreferencesMask -Value ([byte[]](0x90,0x12,0x03,0x80,0x10,0x00,0x00,0x00)) -PropertyType Binary -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Desktop\WindowMetrics' -Name MinAnimate -Value '0' -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced' -Name TaskbarAnimations -Value 0 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Desktop' -Name FontSmoothing -Value '2' -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null
revert:
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\VisualEffects' -Name VisualFXSetting -Value 0 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Desktop\WindowMetrics' -Name MinAnimate -Value '1' -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced' -Name TaskbarAnimations -Value 1 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null

name: Disable Background Apps
description: Stops every Store app from running in the background and eating CPU while you game.
script:
$k = 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\BackgroundAccessApplications'
New-Item -Path $k -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name GlobalUserDisabled -Value 1 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
New-Item -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\AppPrivacy' -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\AppPrivacy' -Name LetAppsRunInBackground -Value 2 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
revert:
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\BackgroundAccessApplications' -Name GlobalUserDisabled -Value 0 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
Remove-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\AppPrivacy' -Name LetAppsRunInBackground -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

name: Remove Startup Delay
description: Kills the artificial 10-second delay before startup apps launch after login.
script:
$k = 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Serialize'
New-Item -Path $k -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name StartupDelayInMSec -Value 0 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null

name: Fast Boot Menu Timeout
description: Cuts the boot-manager timeout to 3 seconds and skips the animated boot logo.
script:
bcdedit /timeout 3
bcdedit /set quietboot on
Write-Host 'Boot timeout set to 3s.'

name: Cap Defender CPU Usage
description: Limits Microsoft Defender scans to 25% CPU so a background scan never ruins your frame times.
script:
Set-MpPreference -ScanAvgCPULoadFactor 25 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
New-Item -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Scan' -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows Defender\Scan' -Name AvgCPULoadFactor -Value 25 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null

name: Disable Core Isolation (VBS)
description: Turns off memory integrity / VBS. Recovers up to 10% CPU performance but lowers security. Reboot required.
script:
$k = 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\DeviceGuard\Scenarios\HypervisorEnforcedCodeIntegrity'
New-Item -Path $k -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name Enabled -Value 0 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\DeviceGuard' -Name EnableVirtualizationBasedSecurity -Value 0 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null

name: Disable Storage Sense
description: Stops Windows from silently deleting files in Downloads and the recycle bin on its own schedule.
script:
$k = 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\StorageSense\Parameters\StoragePolicy'
New-Item -Path $k -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name '01' -Value 0 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null

name: Optimize Drives (TRIM)
description: Runs TRIM on every SSD and a light retrim on HDDs — restores write speed on aging drives.

name: Raise svchost Split Threshold
description: Groups services back into shared svchost processes on high-RAM machines, cutting process count and overhead.
script:
$ram = [int]((Get-CimInstance Win32_ComputerSystem).TotalPhysicalMemory / 1KB)
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control' -Name SvcHostSplitThresholdInKB -Value $ram -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
Write-Host ('Threshold set to ' + $ram + ' KB')

name: Faster App Kill Timeouts
description: Shortens how long Windows waits on frozen apps at shutdown and when you click "End task".
script:
$d = 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Desktop'
New-ItemProperty -Path $d -Name HungAppTimeout -Value '2000' -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $d -Name WaitToKillAppTimeout -Value '2000' -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $d -Name AutoEndTasks -Value '1' -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control' -Name WaitToKillServiceTimeout -Value '2000' -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null
revert:
$d = 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Desktop'
New-ItemProperty -Path $d -Name HungAppTimeout -Value '5000' -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $d -Name AutoEndTasks -Value '0' -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null

name: Disable Telemetry
description: Sets the data-collection policy to Security-only and stops the DiagTrack service and its scheduled tasks.
script:
$k = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DataCollection'
New-Item -Path $k -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name AllowTelemetry -Value 0 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name DoNotShowFeedbackNotifications -Value 1 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\DataCollection' -Name AllowTelemetry -Value 0 -PropertyType DWord -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null
Stop-Service -Name DiagTrack -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Set-Service -Name DiagTrack -StartupType Disabled -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Set-Service -Name dmwappushservice -StartupType Disabled -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
'\Microsoft\Windows\Application Experience\Microsoft Compatibility Appraiser',
'\Microsoft\Windows\Application Experience\ProgramDataUpdater',
'\Microsoft\Windows\Autochk\Proxy',
'\Microsoft\Windows\Customer Experience Improvement Program\Consolidator',
'\Microsoft\Windows\Customer Experience Improvement Program\UsbCeip',
'\Microsoft\Windows\Feedback\Siuf\DmClient' | ForEach-Object {
  Disable-ScheduledTask -TaskName $_ -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null }
Write-Host 'Telemetry disabled.'
revert:
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DataCollection' -Name AllowTelemetry -Value 1 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
Set-Service -Name DiagTrack -StartupType Automatic -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

name: Disable Advertising ID
description: Removes the per-user advertising identifier apps use to profile you across the system.
script:
New-Item -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\AdvertisingInfo' -Force | Out-Null

description: Hides the 3D Objects, Music and Videos shortcut folders from This PC.

name: Add "Open Terminal Here"
description: Adds an admin PowerShell entry to the folder right-click menu.
script:
$k = 'HKCU:\Software\Classes\Directory\Background\shell\ZlagTerminal'
New-Item -Path "$k\command" -Force | Out-Null
Set-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name '(Default)' -Value 'Open PowerShell here (Admin)'
Set-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name 'Icon' -Value 'powershell.exe'
Set-ItemProperty -Path "$k\command" -Name '(Default)' -Value 'powershell.exe -NoExit -Command "Set-Location -Path ''%V''"'

name: Add "Copy as Path"
description: Always-visible "Copy as path" entry, no Shift key required.
script:
$k = 'HKCU:\Software\Classes\*\shell\ZlagCopyPath'
New-Item -Path "$k\command" -Force | Out-Null
Set-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name '(Default)' -Value 'Copy as path'
Set-ItemProperty -Path "$k\command" -Name '(Default)' -Value 'powershell.exe -NoProfile -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "Set-Clipboard -Value ''%1''"'

name: Create God Mode Folder
description: Puts a folder on your desktop containing every Control Panel setting in one flat list.

name: Remove "- Shortcut" Suffix
description: New shortcuts get a clean name with no "- Shortcut" text appended.
script:
$k = 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer'
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name 'link' -Value ([byte[]](0x00,0x00,0x00,0x00)) -PropertyType Binary -Force | Out-Null

name: Skip the Lock Screen
description: Boot straight to the sign-in prompt instead of the lock-screen image.
script:
New-Item -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Personalization' -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Personalization' -Name NoLockScreen -Value 1 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null

name: Verbose Startup Messages
description: Shows what Windows is actually doing during boot and shutdown instead of a spinner.
script: New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System' -Name VerboseStatus -Value 1 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null

name: Detailed Blue Screens
description: BSODs show the full stop-code parameters instead of just a sad face.
script: New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\CrashControl' -Name DisplayParameters -Value 1 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null

name: NumLock On at Startup
description: NumLock is enabled at the login screen and after every boot.
script:
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Keyboard' -Name InitialKeyboardIndicators -Value '2' -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path 'Registry::HKEY_USERS\.DEFAULT\Control Panel\Keyboard' -Name InitialKeyboardIndicators -Value '2' -PropertyType String -Force | Out-Null

name: Silence Notification Center
description: Turns off toast notifications and the focus-assist summary. Nothing pops up mid-match.
script:
$k = 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\PushNotifications'
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name ToastEnabled -Value 0 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
New-Item -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Explorer' -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Explorer' -Name DisableNotificationCenter -Value 1 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
revert:
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\PushNotifications' -Name ToastEnabled -Value 1 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
Remove-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Explorer' -Name DisableNotificationCenter -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

name: Disable Snap Assist Flyout
description: No layout popup when you drag a window to the top of the screen.
script: New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced' -Name EnableSnapAssistFlyout -Value 0 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null

name: Block Lock Screen Camera
description: Nobody can open the camera from your lock screen.
script:
New-Item -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Personalization' -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Personalization' -Name NoLockScreenCamera -Value 1 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null

name: Remove Preinstalled Bloatware
description: Uninstalls the usual junk apps (Bing weather/news, Solitaire, Clipchamp, Teams, Skype, To-Do…). Keeps Store, Calculator, Photos, Terminal.
script:
$targets = @('Microsoft.3DBuilder','Microsoft.BingFinance','Microsoft.BingNews','Microsoft.BingSports',
  'Microsoft.BingWeather','Microsoft.GetHelp','Microsoft.Getstarted','Microsoft.Messaging',
  'Microsoft.Microsoft3DViewer','Microsoft.MicrosoftOfficeHub','Microsoft.MicrosoftSolitaireCollection',
  'Microsoft.MixedReality.Portal','Microsoft.NetworkSpeedTest','Microsoft.Office.OneNote','Microsoft.OneConnect',
  'Microsoft.People','Microsoft.Print3D','Microsoft.SkypeApp','Microsoft.Todos','Microsoft.WindowsFeedbackHub',
  'Microsoft.WindowsMaps','Microsoft.WindowsSoundRecorder','Microsoft.YourPhone','Microsoft.ZuneMusic',
  'Microsoft.ZuneVideo','Clipchamp.Clipchamp','MicrosoftTeams','MSTeams','Microsoft.549981C3F5F10',
  'Microsoft.MicrosoftStickyNotes','Microsoft.WindowsAlarms','Microsoft.PowerAutomateDesktop')
$removed = 0
foreach ($t in $targets) {
  $pkgs = Get-AppxPackage -Name $t -AllUsers -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
  foreach ($p in $pkgs) {
    Remove-AppxPackage -Package $p.PackageFullName -AllUsers -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
    Write-Host ('  removed ' + $p.Name); $removed++ }
  Get-AppxProvisionedPackage -Online -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |
    Where-Object { $_.DisplayName -eq $t } |
    ForEach-Object { Remove-AppxProvisionedPackage -Online -PackageName $_.PackageName -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null } }
Write-Host ('Debloat complete — ' + $removed + ' package(s) removed.')

name: Uninstall OneDrive
description: Stops OneDrive, uninstalls it and removes its Explorer sidebar entry. Your local files stay put.

name: Remove Xbox Apps
description: Uninstalls the Xbox app, Game Bar and Game Overlay packages. Keeps the Gaming Services runtime.

name: Reinstall Default Apps
description: Re-registers every built-in Windows app. The undo button for an over-aggressive debloat.

name: Clean Temp & Prefetch
description: Deletes user temp, Windows temp and prefetch files. Reports how much space was freed.

name: Empty Recycle Bin
description: Permanently deletes everything in the Recycle Bin on every drive.
script: Clear-RecycleBin -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host 'Recycle Bin emptied.'

name: Deep Disk Cleanup
description: Runs the Windows cleanup engine over update leftovers, delivery-optimization files and old logs.
script:
Start-Process cleanmgr.exe -ArgumentList '/verylowdisk' -Wait -WindowStyle Hidden -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Start-Process dism.exe -ArgumentList '/Online /Cleanup-Image /StartComponentCleanup /Quiet /NoRestart' -Wait -WindowStyle Hidden -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Write-Host 'Disk cleanup finished.'

name: Clear Event Logs
description: Wipes every Windows event log — useful before troubleshooting so only fresh errors show up.

name: Repair System Files (SFC)
description: Runs sfc /scannow to find and repair corrupted Windows files. Takes several minutes.
script: sfc /scannow

name: Repair Windows Image (DISM)
description: Runs DISM /RestoreHealth to repair the component store SFC depends on. Takes several minutes.
script: dism.exe /Online /Cleanup-Image /RestoreHealth

name: Create Restore Point
description: Enables System Protection on C: and snapshots the system so any tweak can be rolled back.
script:
Enable-ComputerRestore -Drive 'C:\' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\SystemRestore' -Name SystemRestorePointCreationFrequency -Value 0 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
Checkpoint-Computer -Description 'Z-LAG Toolbox' -RestorePointType 'MODIFY_SETTINGS' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Write-Host 'Restore point created.'

name: Automatic Time & Timezone
description: Fixes the classic "wrong clock" problem by re-enabling automatic time sync and timezone detection.
script:
Set-Service -Name tzautoupdate -StartupType Automatic -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Start-Service -Name tzautoupdate -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Set-Service -Name W32Time -StartupType Automatic -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Start-Service -Name W32Time -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
w32tm /resync /force

name: Use UTC for Hardware Clock
description: Fixes the clock jumping by hours when you dual-boot Windows and Linux.
script: New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\TimeZoneInformation' -Name RealTimeIsUniversal -Value 1 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null

name: Enable Long File Paths
description: Removes the 260-character path limit that breaks node_modules and deep game mod folders.
script: New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\FileSystem' -Name LongPathsEnabled -Value 1 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null

name: Disable NTFS Last-Access Stamps
description: Stops NTFS writing a timestamp every time a file is merely read. Less disk churn.
script: fsutil behavior set disablelastaccess 1

name: Pause Windows Updates
description: Defers feature updates and lets you pause quality updates far longer than the Settings UI allows.
script:
$k = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\WindowsUpdate\UX\Settings'
New-Item -Path $k -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name FlightSettingsMaxPauseDays -Value 3650 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
$k2 = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate'
New-Item -Path $k2 -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k2 -Name DeferFeatureUpdates -Value 1 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k2 -Name DeferFeatureUpdatesPeriodInDays -Value 365 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
Write-Host 'Updates deferred. Security updates still install.'
revert:
Remove-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate' -Name DeferFeatureUpdates -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Remove-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate' -Name DeferFeatureUpdatesPeriodInDays -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

name: No Auto-Restart After Updates
description: Windows will never reboot on its own while you are signed in.
script:
$k = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsUpdate\AU'
New-Item -Path $k -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name NoAutoRebootWithLoggedOnUsers -Value 1 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name AUPowerManagement -Value 0 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null

name: Never Sleep on AC
description: Display and system stay awake while plugged in — no more disconnects during long downloads.
script:
powercfg /change standby-timeout-ac 0
powercfg /change monitor-timeout-ac 0
powercfg /change disk-timeout-ac 0
powercfg /change hibernate-timeout-ac 0

name: Disable USB Selective Suspend
description: Stops Windows powering down USB ports — fixes mice, headsets and controllers cutting out.

name: Lower UAC Prompt Level
description: Stops UAC dimming the desktop on every prompt. Keeps UAC on — it just prompts without the secure desktop.
script:
$k = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System'
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name ConsentPromptBehaviorAdmin -Value 5 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name PromptOnSecureDesktop -Value 0 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
revert:
$k = 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Policies\System'
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name ConsentPromptBehaviorAdmin -Value 5 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path $k -Name PromptOnSecureDesktop -Value 1 -PropertyType DWord -Force | Out-Null

name: Disable Hyper-V Platform
description: Frees the CPU virtualization overhead. Do NOT apply if you use WSL2, Docker Desktop or Android emulators.
script:
Disable-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName Microsoft-Hyper-V-All -NoRestart -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Out-Null
bcdedit /set hypervisorlaunchtype off
Write-Host 'Hyper-V disabled — reboot required.'
